title: BASALT scoped etcd compare-and-advance contention and recovery benchmark
claim_ceiling: Specification and deterministic scenario plan only. No etcd adapter, cluster test, witness integration or performance result is claimed.

scenarios.mutation: Two distinct source lineages use distinct log origins and begin from the same observed store snapshot; transactions compare only their own source/log and unchanged policy keys
scenarios.expected: Both commits succeed sequentially in etcd; neither conflicts solely because the other source committed; both receive distinct store revisions

scenarios.mutation: Two source lineages attempt to advance the same log-origin checkpoint from the same prior cursor
scenarios.expected: Exactly one transaction succeeds; the loser compares against changed log cursor, rereads linearly and re-verifies

scenarios.mutation: Same source lineage and generation receive two different immutable receipt digests
scenarios.expected: At most one is accepted; the other is typed generation equivocation

scenarios.mutation: Receipt A committed at create_revision r1; unrelated receipts advance the global store to rN; exact retry of A occurs
scenarios.expected: Return A's original create_revision r1 and original acceptance context; do not return rN as A's acceptance revision

scenarios.mutation: Existing receipt key digest is presented with conflicting source, generation or seal identity
scenarios.expected: Reject immutable identity mismatch as receipt collision/equivocation

scenarios.mutation: Signer-policy pointer mod_revision changes after proof verification but before compare-and-advance
scenarios.expected: CAS comparison fails; old-policy decision is not committed

scenarios.mutation: Witness roster or witness-policy pointer advances while the candidate is being verified
scenarios.expected: CAS comparison fails or a fresh policy re-evaluation returns unknown; no stale witness quorum accepted

scenarios.mutation: CAS commits the immutable receipt, source cursor and log cursor, but client response is dropped
scenarios.expected: Linearizable exact receipt lookup returns the accepted record and original create_revision; no second advancement

scenarios.mutation: Client receives indeterminate timeout and exact receipt key is absent on linearizable lookup
scenarios.expected: Do not infer commit from a cursor or global revision; take new snapshot and re-verify before retry

scenarios.mutation: Whole etcd cluster is restored from an older internally consistent snapshot
scenarios.expected: Independent monitor/witness detects lower authority checkpoint or verdict remains anti_rollback_unknown

scenarios.mutation: Client supplies serializable member-local stale Range response as evidence of current source/log/policy state
scenarios.expected: Reject freshness promotion; result is unknown until linearizable snapshot is obtained

scenarios.mutation: An unrelated global key advances while all exact relevant source/log/policy scopes remain unchanged
scenarios.expected: Scoped design does not invalidate the claim or trigger application-level conflict; freshness still requires a new linearizable scope read

scenarios.mutation: Leader election or network partition interrupts multi-key compare-and-advance
scenarios.expected: No partial receipt/source/log write; client classifies commit as conflict/unavailable/indeterminate and recovers by exact receipt lookup

scenarios.mutation: Receipt key is deleted and recreated or archived without preserving original creation revision
scenarios.expected: Reject deletion/recreation policy or require a verified immutable archive preserving original acceptance revision and proof material

scenarios.mutation: Source or log cursor key is deleted and recreated with version reset
scenarios.expected: Detect prohibited lineage reset using independent provisioning/authority evidence; no silent generation bootstrap

scenarios.mutation: Restore an older etcd snapshot using --bump-revision and --mark-compacted so the store revision appears monotonic or advances beyond the externally observed revision
scenarios.expected: Independent monitor compares authenticated authority-incarnation identity and accepted-state commitment/predecessor chain; restored state is rejected or unknown even when its numeric revision is larger
